ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is a cyclobutane four-membered ring, and one carbon on the ring is connected to the side-chain reaction center on the right; this reaction center is connected to a dinitrogen/diazo group marked with a positive charge. In the upper right there is a water molecule, with lone-pair electrons drawn beside the oxygen atom. Curved arrows show the lone-pair electrons of the water oxygen attacking this reaction-center carbon, and another curved arrow shows the carbon-nitrogen bond electrons moving toward nitrogen, causing the dinitrogen group to leave. Reasoning: According to the arrow pushing, oxygen forms a new C-O bond with this carbon, while the C-N bond breaks and the diazo group is removed. After a neutral alcohol is formed, the retained carbon skeleton is cyclobutane-CH2-OH, namely hydroxymethylcyclobutane. The corresponding SMILES can be written as OCC1CCC1.

method.method_draft: Identify the electrophilic carbon attached to the cyclobutane substituent and diazonium group. Apply the O-lone-pair arrow to form a C–O bond at that carbon, and apply the C–N arrow to remove the diazo group. The remaining carbon skeleton is cyclobutane–CH2–OH. Convert this connectivity to SMILES as OCC1CCC1.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中左侧是一个环丁烷四元环，环上一个碳连到右侧的侧链反应中心；该反应中心与带正电标记的二氮/重氮基团相连。右上方有水分子，氧原子旁画有孤对电子。弯箭头显示水氧的孤对电子进攻该反应中心碳，另一条弯箭头显示碳-氮键电子移向氮，使二氮基团离去。推理：按照箭头推动，氧与该碳形成新的 C-O 键，同时 C-N 键断裂并去除重氮基团。形成中性醇后，保留的碳骨架是环丁烷-CH2-OH，即羟甲基环丁烷。对应 SMILES 可写为 OCC1CCC1。
